sql: with prior as (select split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) ser, count(*) n, avg(pnl::numeric)*100 c from paper_trades where strategy='mmsell10' and pnl is not null and created_at < '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z' group by 1), fil as (select distinct f.market_ticker t from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Fmmsell10' and o.action='buy' and o.created_at >= '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z'), post as (select split_part(p.market_ticker,'-',1) ser, p.pnl::numeric pn from paper_trades p where p.strategy='Fmmsell10_pt4' and p.pnl is not null and p.created_at >= '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z' and p.market_ticker in (select t from fil)), cls as (select post.pn, case when prior.n is null or prior.n < 30 then 'c_unknown' when prior.c >= 0 then 'a_keep' else 'b_drop' end k from post left join prior using (ser)) select k, count(*) n, round(avg((pn>0)::int)*100,1) win, round(avg(pn)*100,2) c_per, round(sum(pn),2) usd from cls group by 1 order by 1
